validation_rows.evidence_summary: The June 6 prediction is that MCP host runtimes converge on sandboxed local tool execution as the shipped default. The report positions prompt injection as the dominant attack vector mapped to six of ten OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications categories, and its new Real-World Incidents tracker ties concrete failures directly to the MCP and tool-execution surface: the MCP RCE CVE-2025-6514 (CVSS 9.6), an OpenAI Codex CLI sandbox bypass (CVE-2025-59532), the Cursor environment-poisoning flaw CVE-2026-22708, and the March 2026 LiteLLM backdoor that shipped an autonomous attack bot in roughly 47,000 downloads over three hours. The gap to the marker is that the report documents the threat and the CVEs rather than a host runtime actually shipping process or container isolation as the default - it is the strongest case-for-the-default rather than the default itself landing.
